decision_authority: Owner decisions recorded. Registration of an accountable owner is a separate act: a resource group's candidate writer is the accepted reconciling authority, but the group contains that writer, so no component may be registered as the owner of its own group's state without violating the prohibition on self-ownership. Approval states authority; it does not create a self-authorizing writer.
